svg.text: The barrier is people, not data
Share of each firm's first-look reports citing each kind of evidence. Six firms, 273 reports, 2010 to 2026.
reports resting on a person who agreed to talk
First-look reports only — a firm's first report on each target. Follow-ups cite almost nothing and pooling them in reverses firm rankings. Detection
is keyword-based on what a report declares, so every cell is a floor: a firm that uses a terminal without naming it is invisible. The fire-once and
campaign business models are NOT distinguishable on any of these measures (P = 0.065), which is why nothing here is coloured by them.
